summary: Amkor's assembly and test factory in the Yen Phong 2C Industrial Park, Bac Ninh province, northern Vietnam. Announced in November 2021 with a first phase of USD 200-250 million, it was inaugurated in October 2023 as a USD 1.6 billion factory that Amkor said would become its most advanced, starting with advanced System in Package and memory lines; the site is planned to reach 200,000 square metres of cleanroom on 57 acres. Registered capital was raised to USD 1.6 billion in July 2024. In 2026 the plant employed more than 2,000 people, Amkor said its Vietnam output had doubled in a year, and capacity was being raised toward about 3.6 billion products a year.

location.note: Sources name the Yen Phong 2C (II-C) Industrial Park in Bac Ninh province without a street address.
